title: Does the job, but...
text: Does the job, but.... Bought 2 of these, and they'll do the job, but I'm not a fan. The tie hooks are flimsy and you have to keep a equal weight on both ends or it will tilt toward the heavier side. Little things, but big enough that I will look for an alternative next time.
